scouting.recalcNote: The band shows where he's realistically heading with your training. It reflects your CURRENT scout's precision and is recalculated whenever your scout changes, but the rider's actual abilities are never affected.
scouting.notScoutedBody: You don't know this rider's potential yet. Use a scout slot to get your scout's first read on him.
scouting.confidenceTitle_high: You have learned everything your scout can tell you about this rider. How narrow the band is still depends on your scout's rating, not on this.
scouting.confidenceTitle_medium: Your scout has reported more than once, but not everything he can. Scout again to complete the read.
scouting.confidenceTitle_low: A first read only. Scout again before you act on it.
scouting.verdictIsRead: This is your scout's read, not a fact. It is built on his projected level, so another manager's scout can reach a different conclusion about the same rider.
scouting.verdictText: With the right training I see him landing at {progLo}-{progHi} - the role's ceiling is {loft}, but it takes dedicated focus all the way.
scouting.factor_age_upside: Young enough to have seasons of growth ahead
scouting.factor_ceiling_gap: Clear gap between today's level and where he's projected to land
scouting.factor_near_ceiling: Already close to his projected level, little left to gain
scouting.factor_decline_risk: At an age where decline sets in
scouting.factor_value_gap: Priced below what the numbers suggest he is worth
scouting.factor_type_match: The verdict weighs his best rider type most
scouting.factor_form_unknown: Form and fatigue are not visible to scouts
scouting.factor_watch_races: Race results will confirm or challenge this read
scouting.rescoutHint: Scout him again to sharpen the estimate. A low-rated scout reaches his own precision limit before the last level.
scouting.typesSubtitle: the ceiling is the role's, potential sets the pace
scouting.precisionNext: The next scout level narrows the band from ±{half} to ±{next} points.
scouting.precisionUseless: Another level would not visibly narrow the band for your current chief scout (±{half} points). A better chief scout would.
scouting.precisionAtMax: This is as narrow as scouting gets him. The band's width now rests on your chief scout's rating (±{half} points).
scouting.typesLegend: Solid bar = level today. Shaded band = where he's realistically heading with your training: the bottom is steady but unfocused work, the top is dedicated focus every day. Dark mark = the role's ceiling, the same for everyone in that role; potential decides how fast he climbs toward it. It is an estimate, not a guarantee, and no scout knows a rider exactly. Ratings are comparable across roles - the same number means the same level everywhere.
